title: Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE) Schedule Announced
content: The CIE-1 examinations for 3rd semester students will commence from August 25, 2026. Detailed seating arrangement will be published next week.

title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026 Team Registrations Open
content: Teams of 6 students with at least 1 female team member are invited to submit problem statement solutions for university level screening.

title: Semester Tuition Fee Payment Deadline Extension
content: The last date for paying Odd Semester 2026-27 tuition fees without late fine has been extended to August 15, 2026.

title: Library Book Return Notice for Monsoon Term
content: All students holding library books issued during summer recess must renew or return them to avoid daily overdue fines.

title: Placement Drive: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS Digital)
content: Registration link for TCS Digital NQT hiring drive is now live for final year B.Tech, M.Tech, and MCA students.

title: National Seminar on Quantum Computing & Cybersecurity
content: Join IEEE CHARUSAT student branch for an insightful seminar by guest keynote speaker Dr. R. K. Sharma from IIT Bombay.

title: Campus Wi-Fi Security Certificate Renewal
content: Please download and install the renewed CHARUSAT Root SSL Certificate on personal laptops to access campus Wi-Fi.

title: NSS Blood Donation & Preventive Healthcare Camp
content: All students and faculty members are requested to participate in the blood donation drive on August 14 at Charusat Hospital.

title: Guideline for Elective Course Selection for Semester 4
content: Students can choose open electives and department electives via portal preference forms starting next Monday.

title: Hostel Fee Payment & Room Allocation Notice
content: Hostel re-allotment list for academic year 2026-27 has been published. Clear hostel dues before August 5 to confirm occupancy.

title: Code of Conduct & Anti-Ragging Affidavit Submission
content: It is mandatory for all students to upload signed Anti-Ragging undertakings generated from UGC portal to their Student Hub profile.

title: Sports Trials for University Cricket and Football Teams
content: Selection trials for university sports teams will take place at the main sports ground daily between 4:30 PM and 6:30 PM.

title: Student Innovation & Startup Grant Scheme
content: Grants up to Rs. 2,50,000 available for prototype development under Gujarat Student Startup & Innovation Policy (SSIP 2.0).

title: Celebration of Independence Day at University Ground
content: Flag hoisting ceremony will commence at 08:30 AM on August 15. All students, staff, and faculty members are invited.

title: Scholarship Application Portal Open for MYSY & Digital Gujarat
content: Eligible SC/ST/SEBC/EWS students can submit scholarship forms with verified income certificates before the September 30 deadline.
